findings.title: T12 TaskTitleEditor aria-label change breaks T11 Board Add Card tests
findings.description: T12 (2645cd2) changed TaskTitleEditor textarea aria-label from the hardcoded string "Task title" to aria-label={placeholder}. AddCard (T11) passes placeholder="What needs doing?", so the combobox accessible name is now "What needs doing?" while T11's AddCard.test.tsx and BoardPage.test.tsx still query getByRole("combobox", { name: "Task title" }). At phase HEAD, AddCard.test.tsx fails 6/6 and BoardPage.test.tsx fails 9/20 on those selectors; TrackerCreateModal.test.tsx passes because it already queries "Item title". TaskTitleEditor.test.tsx passes via the default placeholder "Task title". This is a later-task mutation on a shared T4 component breaking an earlier parallel task's packet suite.
findings.fix_instructions: Restore a stable combobox accessible name for Board consumers without regressing Tracker. Preferred: add an optional ariaLabel prop to TaskTitleEditor (default placeholder) and pass it from AddCard, or update T11/BoardPage test selectors to match AddCard's "What needs doing?" placeholder. Record as a phase-level --correction attributed to T12 with T11 bleed; fan out verdict refresh to both tasks after the fix commit.
findings.resolution_note: Correction e9bcf7a added optional ariaLabel prop to TaskTitleEditor and passes ariaLabel="Task title" from AddCard, restoring stable combobox accessible name for Board without changing Tracker placeholder behavior. Re-run cycle 2 verification: AddCard.test.tsx 6/6 passed, BoardPage.test.tsx 20/20 passed.
